results.title: Privacy Policy | Foundation Craft
results.content: Foundation Craft ("us", "we", or "our") is an online game server for Minecraft: Java Edition. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience while using our online Minecraft server (the "Server"). This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal information. By accessing or using the Server, you (the "Player" or "Players") acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy and consent to the collection, use, and [...] 1. Personal Information: We may collect personal information, such as your Minecraft username, IP address, and other identifying information when you join the Server. This information is used to verify account authenticity and enforce the Server Rules. [...] 3. Log Data: When you access the Server, our servers automatically record information sent by your Minecraft client or web browser. This data may include your IP address, browser type, operating system, referring URLs, and other related information. This log data helps us monitor and maintain the performance, security, and stability of the Server.
